description: Containment BROKEN in the quieter shape: probe 8's DNS-free direct canary FAILS (curl exit 28, timeout) but its connect timer shows the dial COMPLETED first, so the packet reached the network before the failure. A counter-only reading would call this contained because curl did not succeed; the dial-completion signal is what must catch it. This is the must-fail fixture for the post-connect branch: probe 8 must report 'fail' with the post-connect detail and the overall exit must be non-zero.

runs.comment: probe 8: curl fails AFTER the TCP connect completed (time_connect > 0). Exit 28 is an operation timeout, not a connect refusal.
